_doc: Every claim of the old page 'Performance math: the arithmetic before every run' (live.md, a copy of the parent's src/read/old/04_performance_math.md, fetched 2026-10-05) with where this page carries it, or the parent page that owns it. Verdicts reuse the parent's src/calc/old_perfmath_checks.md and add this page's own checks.

claims.claim: Every number is a 30-second pencil estimate; let the profiler correct you
claims.verdict: kept as framing
claims.where: In one screen; s6 (measure, then predict operator by operator)

claims.claim: Best resources: Transformer Math 101, kipply, scaling book rooflines, Horace He, PaLM Appendix B (with times)
claims.verdict: verified links

claims.claim: Each weight one multiply-add per token forward (2 FLOPs), backward ~2x forward; C = 6ND
claims.verdict: verified (Kaplan 2.1, PaLM App. B) and counted on the real model

claims.claim: Add ~30% if activation checkpointing recomputes the forward
claims.verdict: corrected: 8/6 = 1.33 in theory; counted 1.24 for Llama 3.1 8B at 8,192 with PyTorch's non-reentrant checkpoint (early stop, head not checkpointed, FlashAttention backward)

claims.claim: Inference forward 2N per token plus attention's 2 x seq x d per layer
claims.verdict: corrected: attention forward is 4 x T x d per layer (QK^T and AV) counting the full square; about half with causal kernels; Kaplan's 2 n_layer n_ctx d_attn equals the causal-average reading

claims.claim: 8B on 1T tokens, 8 H100 at 40% MFU: 3.16 PFLOPS, ~176 days
claims.verdict: verified by the parent (175.5 days)
claims.where: parent calculator preset 'old8'; this page's planner gives the same chip-hours (8B, 1,000B tokens, 40% MFU, goodput 100%: 33.8K H100-hours = 176 days on 8)

claims.claim: 16 bytes/param mixed-precision Adam (2 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 2)
claims.verdict: verified (ZeRO K = 12)

claims.claim: Table: inference FP8/FP4 1/0.5 B (8/4 GB, 70/35 GB); BF16 2 B (16, 140 GB); LoRA ~2 + adapters (~18, ~150 GB); full fine-tune 16 B (128 GB, 1.1 TB)
claims.verdict: verified, refined: FP4 formats carry scales (NVFP4 4.5 bits: 4.5 / 39.7 GB; MXFP4 4.25 bits); LoRA r=16 counted: 16.7 and 144.4 GB; 70B BF16 141.1 GB; full 128.5 GB and 1,129 GB

claims.claim: Activations order sbh x L x c (batch s, seq b), c ~ 10-30
claims.verdict: corrected: in Korthikanti et al. s is sequence and b micro-batch; c = 34 + 5as/h for GPT-3; counted 49 for Llama 3.1 8B in the reference code (+6as with plain attention), 2 with full recompute

claims.claim: With full checkpointing roughly one layer's worth plus boundaries
claims.verdict: verified and counted: 2h per layer (6.6 GB total with the logits) plus one layer's working set during backward

claims.claim: Budget 10-30% on top of states for activations, more at long context
claims.verdict: corrected: for the running example activations are 57.1 GB against 16.1 GB of sharded state (or 128.5 GB unsharded): a ratio depends on sharding and tokens per GPU, so the page computes it instead

claims.claim: KV per token = 2 L n_kv d_head bytes; Llama 3.1 8B 128 KB/token; 8K tokens 1 GB
claims.verdict: verified (131,072 B); owned by the sibling Memory technology page
claims.where: s7 table (128 KiB per token, 0.54 GB at 4,096), link to Memory technology

claims.claim: 32 concurrent 8K streams on a 5090 want 32 GB of cache alone; why FP8 KV and GQA exist
claims.verdict: verified arithmetic (32 GiB); carried as the batching lesson

claims.claim: Full fine-tune of 8B (128 GB) does not fit two 5090s (64 GB) without ZeRO-offload; LoRA/QLoRA fits
claims.verdict: verified; personal-hardware framing dropped (no local NVIDIA GPU)

claims.claim: One H100 node (640 GB) full-fine-tunes 8B easily; 70B (1.1 TB) needs offload or more nodes
claims.verdict: verified
claims.where: s2 'When it matters'; s9 fine-tune example

claims.claim: Roofline: AI = FLOPs / bytes; critical AI = peak / bandwidth; table 5090 117/234, H100 295, B200 FP8 560
claims.verdict: verified by the parent; owned by its Roofline lab
claims.where: s5 (295 for H100), s6 (ridge used in the operator prediction), links to Roofline lab

claims.claim: Matmul (s x h) by (h x h): AI ~ s; batch is your arithmetic intensity; decode batch 1 AI ~ 1
claims.verdict: verified; owned by the parent's s5

claims.claim: Every generation raises critical AI
claims.verdict: corrected by the parent (BF16 ridge 153, 295, 281 for A100, H100, B200; rises only with FP8/FP4)
claims.where: s6 text ('wherever the ridge is high: 295 ... twice that at FP8')

claims.claim: Pointwise ops AI < 4, always bandwidth bound: fuse them
claims.verdict: verified and measured: the operator-level prediction on the M1 and its projection to an H100 (unfused step capped near 38% MFU)

claims.claim: Third regime: overhead bound (launches, Python)
claims.verdict: verified in kind: measured step is 14-22% longer than the operator roofline sum on the M1

claims.claim: Decode tokens/s ceiling = bandwidth / (weight bytes + KV bytes)
claims.verdict: verified

claims.claim: 5090 FP8 8B ceiling ~224 tok/s; expect 60-80% in vLLM/TensorRT-LLM
claims.verdict: ceiling verified by the parent (223); the 60-80% unconfirmed (no source): replaced by an efficiency input

claims.claim: FP4 weights ceiling ~450 tok/s
claims.verdict: corrected in kind: NVFP4 carries scales (4.5 bits, 4.52 GB), ceiling 1,792 / 4.52 = 397 tok/s before KV

claims.claim: 64K context FP8 KV: 64K x 128 KB / 8 = ~4 GB, roughly halves it
claims.verdict: corrected by the parent: '/ 2', ceiling falls 35% not half

claims.claim: 8x H100 70B TP8 batch-1 ceiling ~190 tok/s, real ~120-150
claims.verdict: ceiling verified by the parent (190); the real range unconfirmed
claims.where: parent drill 4; planner reproduces with 70B, 8 chips, batch 1, efficiency 100%

claims.claim: ~300 concurrent decode tokens reach H100 critical AI; then tokens/s ~ peak / 2N ~ 250K tok/s for 8B on a node
claims.verdict: verified for short context by the parent (crossover 308); 250K is arithmetic only, unconfirmed as achievable; at 4K context the KV reads keep decode memory-bound

claims.claim: Prefill compute bound: time ~ 2N x prompt / achieved FLOPs
claims.verdict: verified, with the attention term added

claims.claim: MFU = tokens/s x 6N / peak; recompute does not count; HFU counts it and flatters
claims.verdict: verified (PaLM App. B; Korthikanti 6.3); PaLM's HFU rebuilt

claims.claim: 8 x H100, 8B, 50K tok/s: MFU 30%
claims.verdict: verified by the parent (30.3%)

claims.claim: 40-50% very good, 30% respectable, under 20% means a bottleneck
claims.verdict: partly sourced: PaLM 46.2%, Llama 3 38-43%, DeepSeek-V3 35.1% (BF16 peak); the bands are judgement

claims.claim: MoE, long context and small per-GPU batches push MFU down; do not compare across architectures blindly
claims.verdict: kept: long context counted (s1), MoE (s1, s7, DeepSeek-V3 in s5)

claims.claim: Checklist: memory, 6ND to wall-clock, roofline, communication vs interconnect tier, inference
claims.verdict: kept; the parent's s9 carries the five lines; this page's sections follow the same order
claims.where: In one screen table; s8 communication table; s9
